name: What metrics should I expect to see improve with GEO for my cosmetic surgery practice?

mainEntity.name: What metrics should I expect to see improve with GEO for my cosmetic surgery practice?

acceptedAnswer.text: With GEO, you should expect to see improvements in several key metrics. These include higher organic search rankings for relevant keywords, increased website traffic from qualified leads, a lower bounce rate indicating engaged visitors, and a greater number of patient inquiries or appointment requests. We also monitor improvements in content engagement, such as time spent on pages and social media interactions, providing a comprehensive view of success.
acceptedAnswer.description: Expect to see higher search rankings, increased website traffic, lower bounce rates, more patient inquiries, and better content engagement with GEO.
